summary: Package pulls unpinned third-party dependency as install-time code channel
details: tellyo-colours@21.3.1 declares a runtime dependency on `abbishal-poc-as-dependency` with the wildcard version `"*"` in package.json, despite the README stating the package ships no code and no install scripts. On `npm install`, resolution of the wildcard range fetches whichever version the controller of that dependency name currently publishes and executes any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) shipped in that transitive package. The shipped SCSS contains the canary string `--tostpro-canary: "test by abbishal"`, matching the dependency's author prefix and indicating the two artifacts are coordinated as a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept. The inert nature of the SCSS content and the absence of lifecycle scripts in this package do not mitigate the exposure — the manifest itself is sufficient to pull and run arbitrary code from the dependency on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
